name: Magnetoresistance of a bulk crystal at 2 K up to 10 T in a Quantum Design PPMS
plain_name: Measure how a sample responds to a magnetic field

sources.citation: Nowakowska, P., Pavlosiuk, O., Wiśniewski, P., Kaczorowski, D. (2023). Temperature-dependent Fermi surface probed by Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations in topological semimetal candidates DyBi and HoBi. Scientific Reports 13, 22776.
sources.note: Full text read from the arXiv copy (arXiv:2401.02294) of the published open-access article.

sources.citation: Rao, K., Allen, K., Gao, Y., Arushi, Mishra, S., Singh, B., Burch, K. S., Deng, L., Saha, S. R., Paglione, J., Lee, M., Zapf, V., Morosan, E. (2026). A Strategy Toward Room Temperature Topological Hall Effect via Local Moment Magnetism. arXiv:2609.03223 [cond-mat.mtrl-sci].
sources.doi_note: arXiv abstract page lists this DOI as pending registration; doi.org resolution not confirmed in this session.

reported_conditions.as_printed: T = 2 K and in B = 14 T

requirements.rationale: User-specified target field for this measurement (demo value); the papers report up to 14 T, see reported_conditions.
Nowakowska et al. (2023) report magnetoresistance at T = 2 K; this is the paper's operating point, confirmed by the user.
Rao et al. (2026) used the electrical transport option of a PPMS DynaCool for magnetotransport; Nowakowska et al. do not name the option. User confirms an AC transport module is required.
Nowakowska et al. (2023) report single crystals up to 3 × 3 × 3 mm; the sample space must accept a 3 mm wide sample. Crystal size is this paper's material, confirmed by the user.
Nowakowska et al. (2023) report single crystals up to 3 × 3 × 3 mm; the sample space must accept a 3 mm long sample. This paper's material, confirmed by the user.
Nowakowska et al. (2023) report single crystals up to 3 × 3 × 3 mm; the sample space must accept a 3 mm tall sample. This paper's material, confirmed by the user.

missing_information: measurement option (ETO vs Resistivity) not named by Nowakowska et al.
contact material and number of contacts beyond 'four-probe' not stated
field orientation relative to current stated only as 'transverse' (Nowakowska) / 'along [120]' (Rao)
confirmation_note: Requirements reviewed and confirmed by the profile author on 2026-10-31 against the quoted evidence records. Any edited value must be re-confirmed by the user before the profile is used.
